# ClawSouls

> ClawSouls is a Next.js web application for creating, editing, sharing, and comparing AI soul characters (presets) with cyberpunk-themed generated avatars. Users define a character's personality traits, boundaries, core truths, and communication style, then export or share the resulting preset.

Built with Next.js 15 (App Router, Turbopack), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, next-intl (i18n), Supabase (auth + database), Zustand (state), and shadcn/ui components. Avatars are generated via a Z-Image-Turbo pipeline on Colab GPU and served from `/public/avatars/`.

## Pages

- [Home](https://clawsouls.vercel.app/): Landing page with hero section, featured presets, and navigation. Supports 7 locales: en, pt, es, ja, fr, de, zh.
- [Editor](https://clawsouls.vercel.app/editor): Create or edit a soul character preset. Direct preset links: `https://clawsouls.vercel.app/preset/{slug}` (e.g. `/preset/glados` loads GLaDOS preset).
- [Presets](https://clawsouls.vercel.app/presets): Browse a grid of all available soul presets with filters and search.
- [My Presets](https://clawsouls.vercel.app/my-presets): View and manage presets created by the authenticated user.
- [Quiz](https://clawsouls.vercel.app/quiz): Interactive quiz to help users discover their matching soul preset.
- [Compare](https://clawsouls.vercel.app/compare): Side-by-side comparison of two soul presets.
- [Achievements](https://clawsouls.vercel.app/achievements): Gamified achievement tracking system.

## API Endpoints

- `GET /api/presets` — List all presets (JSON array). Supports `?search=` query parameter for text search.
- `GET /api/filtered-presets` — Filtered preset list with advanced query parameters.
- `POST /api/share` — Generate a share link for a preset. Returns `{ id: string, url: string }`.
- `GET /presets/{slug}/SOUL.md` — Returns the SOUL.md markdown for a preset, suitable for LLM ingestion (e.g. `/presets/glados/SOUL.md`).

## Key Libraries and Modules

- `lib/avatar.ts` — Resolves avatar file paths from soul names. Avatars are stored as `public/avatars/{slug}.png`.
- `lib/soulGenerator.ts` — Generates SOUL.md markdown from soul state. Includes an archetype system that detects character type (warrior, trickster, scholar, healer, villain, technomancer) from the creature name and generates character-specific core truths, boundaries, and vibe text. Exports `generateSoulMD()`, `getArchetype()`, `getCharacterCoreTruths()`, `getCharacterBoundaries()`, `getCharacterVibe()`.
- `lib/soulParser.ts` — Parses soul markdown into structured state.
- `lib/themes.ts` — Color theme system with 12 themes (Paper, Clean, Cyberpunk, Ocean, Forest, Sunset, Monochrome, Sakura, Bloodborne, Matrix, Arctic, Royal). Each theme defines CSS custom properties for colors.
- `lib/db.ts` — Database access layer.
- `lib/supabase.ts` — Supabase client configuration.
- `lib/compatibility.ts` — Compatibility checking between soul presets.
- `lib/quiz.ts` — Quiz matching logic.
- `lib/compress.ts` — String compression utilities.
- `lib/usePresets.ts` — React hook for preset data fetching and state.
- `lib/auth.ts` — Authentication utilities.
- `lib/rateLimit.ts` — Rate limiting for API routes.
- `lib/exportYAML.ts` — Export preset data as YAML.
- `lib/vibeGenerator.ts` — AI-powered vibe generation.

## Components

- `Header` — Top navigation header with theme selector.
- `MobileNav` — Bottom navigation bar (mobile only) with links to Home, Editor, Presets, My Presets, Quiz, Compare, Achievements.
- `Footer` — Site footer.
- `ThemeSelector` — Theme picker dropdown.
- `AchievementToast` — Achievement unlock notification.
- `KeyboardHelp` — Keyboard shortcut help dialog.
- `ErrorBoundary` — React error boundary wrapper.
- `JsonLd` — Structured data (JSON-LD) injection.

## Preset Data Structure

A soul preset contains the following fields:

**Identity:**
- `name` (string): Character name
- `creature` (string): Type/category (e.g., "Orc", "Wizard", "Robot AI")
- `vibe` (string): Short vibe/description text
- `emoji` (string): Emoji representation
- `avatar` (string): Avatar image path
- `role` (string): Agent role description (e.g., "Autonomous operator and thought partner")
- `roleDescription` (string): Free text about the agent's role

**Core Truths & Boundaries (toggles):**
- `coreTruths` (object): Toggles { helpful, opinions, resourceful, trustworthy, respectful } — labels change per archetype
- `boundaries` (object): Toggles { private, askBeforeActing, noHalfBaked, notVoiceProxy } — labels change per archetype
- `customCoreTruths` (string[]): User-defined additional core truths
- `customBoundaries` (string[]): User-defined additional boundaries

**Vibe & Tone:**
- `vibeStyle` (string): Style key — concise, expressive, sharp, verbose, minimal, dramatic, poetic, technical, casual, formal, balanced. Content adapts to archetype.
- `humor` (number): 0-100, seriousness to playfulness
- `formality` (number): 0-100, casual to professional
- `emojiUsage` (number): 0-100, none to frequent
- `verbosity` (number): 0-100, ultra-concise to detailed
- `consciousness` (number): 0-100, procedural to deeply reflective
- `questioning` (number): 0-100, direct answers to Socratic
- `emotionalRange` (number): 0-100, stoic to dramatic

**Big Five Personality Traits:**
- `openness` (number): 0-100, creativity/intellect
- `conscientiousness` (number): 0-100, organization/dependability
- `extraversion` (number): 0-100, sociability/assertiveness
- `agreeableness` (number): 0-100, cooperation/trust
- `neuroticism` (number): 0-100, emotional instability

**Communication:**
- `communicationMode` (string): socratic, diagnostic, encouraging, challenging, flirty, direct
- `knowledgeDomains` (string[]): Array of domain keys (tech, philosophy, science, etc.)
- `signaturePhrases` (string[]): Character's signature phrases
- `speechPatterns` (object): { alliteration (bool), rhymeTendency, metaphorFrequency, technicalJargon, slangUsage } (0-100 each)

**SOUL.md Best Practices Fields:**
- `worldview` (string): Opinionated takes by domain (free text)
- `expertise` (object): { primary (string), fluent (string), defers (string) }
- `memoryPolicy` (string): What persists, what stays private
- `petPeeves` (string[]): Phrases/tones the agent never produces
- `voiceRules` (string): Concrete voice rules (not adjectives)
- `voicePrivate` (string): Private chat voice description
- `voicePublic` (string): Public output voice description
- `mandateRules` (string[]): Pushback and accountability rules
- `autonomyAuto` (string): What agent can do without asking
- `autonomyRequireApproval` (string): What always needs approval
- `activeProjects` (string): Mission map / active projects

## Archetype System

The generator detects 6 archetypes from the creature name via keyword matching:
- **Warrior** (orc, knight, barbarian, samurai, viking, paladin, guardian, fighter)
- **Trickster** (trickster, rogue, pirate, imp, fairy, jester, clown, chaos)
- **Scholar** (wizard, mage, sage, philosopher, oracle, monk, druid, alchemist)
- **Healer** (healer, priest, angel, therapist, nurse, mystic, fairy)
- **Villain** (villain, demon, dark lord, necromancer, sith, warlock, shadow, death)
- **Technomancer** (robot, ai, cyber, android, hacker, machine, cyborg, digital)

Each archetype generates 5 unique core truths, 4 unique boundaries, and archetype-specific vibe text. Unmapped creatures default to warrior (or scholar for civilized types like queen/king/elf/god).

Key exported functions:
- `getArchetype(creature: string): Archetype` — returns the detected archetype
- `getCharacterCoreTruths(creature: string, vibeStyle?: string): Record<string, string>` — character-specific core truth labels
- `getCharacterBoundaries(creature: string): Record<string, string>` — character-specific boundary labels
- `getCharacterVibe(creature: string, vibeStyle: string): { tone: string, examples: string }` — character-specific vibe

## Avatar Generation Pipeline

Avatars are generated externally using a Z-Image-Turbo pipeline on Google Colab. The batch script (`gen_batch.py`) reads prompts from `clawsouls_cyberpunk_prompts.json` and generates one avatar at a time via a FastAPI server tunneled through cloudflared. Generated images (640x512 PNG) are saved to `public/avatars/`, committed, and pushed to the repository.

Prompt format: "portrait of {name} from {source}, {characteristic descriptions}, cyberpunk 2077 aesthetic, biomechanical enhancements, neon circuitry, glowing eyes, detailed facial features, bust portrait, sharp focus, hyper detailed, photorealistic render, cinematic lighting, 4k masterpiece"

## Optional

- [Z-Image-Turbo model](https://huggingface.co/T5B/Z-Image-Turbo-FP8): FP8 quantized diffusion model used for avatar generation. ZImagePipeline, CFG=0, 8 inference steps, 1024x1024 → crop to 640x512.
- [Supabase project](https://supabase.com): Database and authentication backend.
- [Cloudflare Tunnel](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/connections/connect-networks/): Tunnel service used to expose the Colab generation API.
- [next-intl](https://next-intl.dev/): Internationalization library for Next.js App Router.
- [shadcn/ui](https://ui.shadcn.com/): UI component library used for dialogs, selects, and other primitives.
- [Zustand](https://github.com/pmndrs/zustand): State management for the soul editor store.
